cd /tmp/mt-rep-HmwGJb/repo; cat > wordcount.py <<'EOF'
def count_words(text: str) -> int:
    total = 0
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.lstrip().startswith('#'):
            continue
        total += len(line.split())
    return total
EOF
cat >> tests/test_wordcount.py <<'EOF'


def test_indented_comment_line_is_skipped():
    assert count_words('   \t# note here\nhello\n') == 1


def test_hash_after_first_non_blank_is_not_a_comment():
    assert count_words('hello # world\n') == 3


def test_words_split_on_any_whitespace_run():
    assert count_words('a  b\tc \t d\n') == 4


def test_words_split_across_lines_and_blank_lines():
    assert count_words('a\n\n   \nb c') == 3


def test_empty_text_has_no_words():
    assert count_words('') == 0


def test_only_comments_has_no_words():
    assert count_words('# a\n  # b c\n#d') == 0
EOF
